name: MTAR Technologies Ltd
title: MTAR Technologies Ltd - 543270 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: MTAR guides FY27 revenue growth to 80%+ (±5%) and EBITDA margin ~24%, backed by INR250-300 crore two-year capex and a clean-energy build-out; margin delivery is the unproven leg after FY26 margin slipped to 19.5%.

capex.peers_comment: Analyst noted a large customer's aggressive multifold US capacity expansion; management did not comment on peers' capacity.
capex.quote: we're looking at around INR250 crores to INR300 crores of capex, which we are looking at to build all these capacities

triggers.label: FY27 growth guided 80%+ vs 50% prior
triggers.quote: we are raising our guidance for FY '27 from 50% revenue growth to 80% plus - revenue growth, plus/minus 5%

triggers.label: Capex INR250-300 crore over 2 years
triggers.quote: we're looking at around INR250 crores to INR300 crores of capex

triggers.label: NWC days 278 to 172
triggers.quote: we ended with net working capital days of 172 days compa red to the previous quarter of 278 days

triggers.label: Gross margin 49.4% to 47.7%
triggers.quote: Our gross margins are at 47.7% and when c ompared to last year's 49.4%, were also impacted

triggers.label: Order book missed FY26 target
triggers.quote: The closing order book for FY '26 is at INR2,580 crores, and we had given a guidance of INR2,800 crores.

guidance.quote: we are raising our guidance for FY '27 from 50% revenue growth to 80% plus - revenue growth, plus/minus 5%
with clear EBITDA margins of around 24% for the year
the estimated closing order book would be close to about INR5,000 crores at the end of the year
we wanted to maintain a debt-to-equity ratio of, for next 2 years, in the range of around 0.5
the oil and gas plant will also be commissioned by September end and will be fully operational
